rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who reads, including the audience of a publication.

example.english: Every reader said this article was great.
example.traditional: 每個讀者都話呢篇文好睇。
example.jyutping: mui5 go3 duk6 ze2 dou1 waa6 ni1 pin1 man4 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for a primer or elementary reading textbook.

example.english: This reader is used at school to teach children Chinese.
example.traditional: 學校用呢本讀本教小朋友學中文。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 jung6 ni1 bun2 duk6 bun2 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hok6 zung1 man4

rows.note: Use this for a device that reads or retrieves data, especially in technical contexts.

example.english: The reader can retrieve the data on this card immediately.
example.traditional: 部讀取器可以即刻讀取張卡嘅資料。
example.jyutping: bou6 duk6 ceoi2 hei3 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 duk6 ceoi2 zoeng1 kaat1 ge3 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for glasses used to help with reading.

example.english: I’m a reader, so I need reading glasses to read small print.
example.traditional: 我戴咗老花眼鏡先睇到細字。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 zo2 lou5 faa1 ngaan5 geng3 sin1 tai2 dou2 sai3 zi6
